summary: Instagram's new Add products tool takes full LTK and ShopMy collection links as well as Amazon links (US and Canada), so link-in-bio and storefront players now plug straight into Reels and posts.

YouTube Shopping's affiliate program launched in Australia with Amazon.com.au, and its tags auto-localise links and currency for overseas viewers. Meesho in India is opening 30 million products to YouTube Shopping creators.
Follow-up coverage of the old Bitly link hijack spread to Malwarebytes, PC Gamer and others.
Lasso and URLgenius were quiet. Button posted only a LinkedIn thought piece, and Amazon's own news is the Instagram integration (see Industry Watch).
